limited_go: Isolated WSL small integration tests only; no official publication, new production seal, 194-case run or ML handover authorized by this review.

findings.title: General publication bypasses the common ionic-record validator
findings.discovery_scope: Reproduces an explicitly disclosed omission; not a new P1 or reopening of fixed stop-path RGLR-01/02
findings.impact: Incoherent sigma representations or a missing ratio can be published as network success and sent toward Stage E; tau handover correctly rejects them.
findings.limitation: Coherent mutations after an actual network CLI run; Stage E is stubbed. No assertion of current unmutated solver producing the forged ratio.

findings.title: Failed rollback leaves mixed generations labeled previous_generation_kept=true
findings.discovery_scope: Additional synchronous rollback-failure boundary, distinct from acknowledged kill-9 non-atomicity
findings.impact: Old network sigma 0.012012 mS/cm and new full_metrics sigma 0.008755 mS/cm remain together while active_status=success and the UI claims prior values unchanged.
findings.limitation: Requires publication and rollback I/O failures; pipeline itself correctly returns failed. Ordinary one-fault rollback preserves all six files.

findings.title: Clamping a negative expanded VM radicand fabricates computed CV
findings.discovery_scope: Numerical answer to request Q4; known clamp behavior independently falsified for near-hydrostatic nonzero deviatoric stress
findings.impact: Two exactly equal diagonal VM values yield CV=100% and computed, versus exact CV=0%.
findings.limitation: Near-hydrostatic boundary at very small absolute VM; incidence or effect size in the real 194 cases is not measured.
